info.name: PlayPortal API Collection - Complete
info.description:
Complete API collection for PlayPortal Tournament Management System.

🎯 FEATURES:
- Authentication: JWT-based with register/login/Google OAuth
- Tournament Management: Organizations, tournaments, categories, teams
- Court Management: Create courts, assign matches, auto-queue system
- Fixture Types: Knockout (KO), Round Robin (RR), Round Robin + Knockout (RR_KO)
- Match Scheduling: Direct scheduling system (no brackets - deprecated)
- Score Management: Real-time updates for set-based and simple scoring
- Automatic Progression: Winner advancement, auto KO creation in RR_KO, court queue management

🔐 AUTHENTICATION:
- JWT Bearer token in Authorization header: Bearer <token>
- Get token from: POST /auth/register/, /auth/login/, /auth/google/
- Token expiration: 30 days (timezone-aware)
- Field: 'is_organizer' for organizer status

🏟️ FIXTURE TYPES:
1. KO (Knockout): Single elimination - organizer creates matches with team pairings
2. RR (Round Robin): All teams play each other - auto-generated matches
3. RR_KO: Hybrid - RR phase (auto), then top 50% advance to KO (auto-created)

⚽ SCORING TYPES:
- Set-based: Volleyball, Badminton (best of N sets, first to X points)
- Simple: Football, Hockey (single score per team)

🎾 COURT SYSTEM:
- Tournament-scoped with unique names
- Auto-queue: Matches queue when court occupied
- Auto-advance: Court advances to next queued match on completion

🚀 WORKFLOW CHANGES (Oct 2025):
- ❌ REMOVED: Bracket system (bracket_matches deprecated)
- ✅ NEW: Direct match creation and scheduling
- ✅ RR_KO: Automatic KO match creation when RR completes
- ✅ Current phase tracking: 'round_robin' or 'knockout' (transition removed)
- ✅ All matches managed through stage_number and match_number

✅ VERIFIED: All endpoints tested and working (Oct 2025)
- No errors in codebase
- All 3 fixture types functional
- Score updates with automatic progression
- Court assignment and queue management operational

Register a new user. Returns a JWT token and user object on success.
Login with email and password. Response contains JWT token.
Verify Google ID token on the server and sign in / create user. Returns JWT token on success.
Logout user. With Bearer token authentication, logout is handled client-side by removing the token from storage.
Get lists of upcoming tournaments (future start dates) and past tournaments (past end dates), limited to 4 of each.

header.description: Required: JWT token for organizer authentication

request.description: Create knockout matches with organizer-selected team pairings for set-based sports (volleyball/badminton). Organizer decides first round matchups. System automatically creates all rounds including semi-finals and finals with TBD placeholders for future matches. Winners progress automatically.

header.description: Required: JWT token for organizer authentication

request.description:
Create knockout stage matches with simple scoring (e.g., football, hockey). Organizer decides team pairings. Single score per team, highest score wins. System creates all rounds including semi-finals and finals with TBD placeholders for future matches.

IMPORTANT: You must provide team pairings in the 'matches' array. For simple scoring sports, no_sets and points_win are not required.
